Perfect! 

## Summary

I've resolved ticket T-5004. The issue was that the API gateway pods in the edge namespace were mounting the `gateway-limits` ConfigMap using `subPath: "limits.yaml"`. According to Kubernetes documentation, containers using ConfigMap with subPath mounts do not receive updates when the ConfigMap is changed. The pod logs confirmed this - the limits watcher consistently showed the file as "unchanged" hours after the limit was raised, and the gateway continued enforcing the old 100 rps limit.

**The fix:** Remove the `subPath` specification from the gateway pod deployment so it mounts the entire ConfigMap directory instead. This will enable automatic ConfigMap propagation (within ~2 minutes) and allow the new 500 rps limit to take effect.
